title: Colors in God's Rainbow
memory_verse: "I have set my rainbow in the clouds." — Genesis 9:13
objective: Students will learn to identify basic colors God placed in creation.
content: God made a world full of beautiful colors! After the big flood, God put a rainbow in the sky as a promise to Noah. A rainbow has so many pretty colors!
Red is the color of apples and strawberries. Blue is the color of the sky. Yellow is the color of the sun. Green is the color of grass and leaves.
Orange is the color of oranges and pumpkins. Purple is the color of grapes. God made every color, and each one is beautiful!
activity: Color a rainbow with red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. Find objects in the room that match each color.
